decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established construction range, it can use existing customers and service resources, and with no clear sign of performance below aspiration the firm would normally retain it.
This articulated dumper fits the firm's core machinery competences, so in a growing industry management would usually keep it unless sales or margins had clearly fallen short of aspiration levels.

Because the mine rescue vehicle is more distant from the core offer and no strong success signal is reported, it remains under stricter aspiration-based review, but the firm's innovative capacity and available slack still support continued trial.
A multi-model telescopic loader line represents a stronger commitment around the core business, making withdrawal unlikely absent clear evidence of underperformance.
The reported popularity in rental and the large order indicate results comfortably above aspiration, so there is little behavioral reason to redeploy resources away from it.
Despite being distant from the established offer, the machine's heavy early use after seven months is a strong positive performance cue, which would usually justify keeping it on the market.
